title: Survival-Friend
description: prevents creeper block damage and crop trampling, enables portal based farms on SMP, offers /tpa features and global totem pop messages and the ability to make the ender dragon a bit harder.
body:
# Survival Friend - The only plugin you'll need!

## This plugin provides advanced features to enhance your SMP:
- **No creeper damage to blocks and/or players**
- **No crop-trampling for players or mobs**
- **/ec , /wb , /compass  commands**
- **Mobs far away don't despawn anymore (Portal based farms)**
- **/tpa  feature with 60 minutes cooldown between requests**
- **Custom HP for the Ender Dragon**
- **Totem of undying pops will be broadcasted to global chat**
- everything can be disabled or enabled via the  /menufs  command

## Setup instructions:
1. Download the latest release from modrinth
2. Put the .jar-File into your /plugins/ folder and start the server
3. Use /menufs as an op to enable/disable the features

## Detailed features list:
- **Creeper**: You can toggle whether creepers should be able to _destroy blocks_ or _damage players_. (You can toggle both options on or off)
- **Crop Trampling**: You can toggle whether players or mobs should be able to destroy crops by stepping on them. (You can toggle both options on or off)
- **TPA**: Players are able to send /tpa requests to other players. This command has a 60 minutes cooldown between requests. The cooldown is not editable right now.
- **Portal based farms**: This plugin enables portal based farms on SMP-Servers by preventing _Guardians, Iron Golems, Creepers, Whither Skeletons_ and _Piglins_ from despawning when far away from a player. The moblist cannot be edited right now.
- **Harder Dragon**: The Dragon's health can be edited in the config file. When the feature is enabled, the ender dragon will (re)spawn with more or less HP.
- **Totem pop notification**: If a totem of undying is used to prevent death, the plugin will broadcast a message to the enrie server with a "totem pop message", similar to the default death message.
- **Enderchest, Workbench**: This plugin offers the ability to open your enderchest and a workbench when using /ec or /wb . These features can be toggled to be on/of or to be only used by admins (op).
- **Compass**: You can use this command to let your compass point to a player or to given coordinated. Useful when you dont play with a minimap/bluemap.
